WITH current_original AS ( SELECT v.id, v.content_hash FROM chapters c JOIN chapter_content_variants v ON v.chapter_id = c.id AND v.variant_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND v.content_hash = c.source_hash WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT c.id, c.story_version_id, c.row_version, v.content_hash AS source_hash, v.content AS source_text, v.id AS content_variant_id, v.language_code, v.source_variant_id, c.source_hash AS chapter_source_hash, v.source_content_hash, current_original.id AS current_original_variant_id, CASE WHEN ( (v.variant_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND v.content_hash = c.source_hash) OR (v.variant_type = 'TRANSLATION' AND v.translation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND v.source_variant_id = current_original.id AND v.source_content_hash = c.source_hash) ) THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS stale FROM chapters c JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id JOIN chapter_content_variants v ON v.chapter_id = c.id LEFT JOIN current_original ON TRUE WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} AND p.id = #{projectId} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND
v.variant_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND v.content_hash = c.source_hash
v.id = #{contentVariantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1
